title: Comparing Make.com Pricing 2026 Plans and Real Costs
summary: Make.com pricing depends on your monthly operation volume, allowing you to select the tier that aligns with your specific automation requirements.
body_markdown:
## Make.com pricing structures and plan tiers


### The Free plan entry point


The Free plan provides **[1,000](https://www.make.com/pricing) credits per month** at a cost of $0, which means you can automate basic tasks without any financial commitment. This allows you to experiment with basic triggers without an immediate financial commitment Make.


While this is a low-friction starting point, the limit includes every operation. A single run of a ten-step workflow can only execute 100 times before the account halts until the next billing cycle.


### Core, Pro, and Teams tiers compared


As your automation needs grow, you'll move into paid tiers (see[Make pricing in 2026](https://www.activepieces.com/blog/makecom-pricing-2026-plans-credits-and-real-costs) for a full breakdown). These tiers unlock higher execution speeds and advanced features: priority scenario processing is one example.


Recent pricing adjustments have lowered the entry barrier for high-volume users.


Plan Tier Monthly Cost (10k Credits) Primary Benefit


Core $9 Unlimited active scenarios for basic builders.


Pro $16 Custom variables and full-text search in execution history.


Teams $38 Shared folders and team-based permission sets.


*Prices and plan limits checked against[make.com](https://make.com/en/pricing) on October 12, 2026.*


The Core plan at $9 per month (down from $12) is the baseline for you if you need more than two active workflows[SpendChime](https://www.spendchime.com/history/make) , so you save $36 annually compared to the previous pricing.


Upgrading to the Pro tier at $16 per month enables the use of custom variables, allowing you to build more complex logic, which means your automation budget stretches further than it did under the previous pricing.


You can store environment-specific data like API keys without hardcoding them into every module.


The Teams tier starts at $29 per month, providing the controls needed for scaling your operations, so you can expand your team's capacity without increasing your overhead.


It provides the administrative controls necessary for multiple staff members to collaborate on the same canvas. The visual builder allows for complex logic, but as steps increase, so does the credit consumption.


The screenshot below displays the Data Selector modal where you can map these variables. The "STRIPE_PROD" variable shown ensures that an[Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com/) or Make workflow can switch between environments without manual edits. This variable management is essential for maintaining clean code steps within the flow.


### Make.com enterprise pricing and scaling costs


For high-volume operations, Make’s mid-market pricing remains significantly lower than many competitors. It lacks the flat-rate predictability of self-hosted alternatives.


The Teams plan starts at[$38](https://www.make.com/pricing) per month, which means you can scale your automation infrastructure without a heavy initial financial commitment.


This is a fraction of the $103.50 required for a[Zapier Team](https://saastruecost.com/software/make-com/pricing/) plan or the $800 entry point for[n8n Business](https://saastruecost.com/software/make-com/pricing/) \[SaaS True Cost\], indicating significant potential savings for your budget, as you are avoiding the premium costs associated with those competitors, which means you can reallocate capital to other growth-driving initiatives.


High-frequency polling or heavy data processing triggers custom pricing based on total operation volume.
